components.name: AppHeader
components.summary: The 64px white bar on every screen: wordmark, tagline, the Frozen demo badge when the frozen demo runs, and the main navigation.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Three variants: primary for the one action a view exists for, secondary for the rest, ghost for quiet actions inside dense rows.

components.name: CaseCardSection
components.summary: A titled group of field rows on the case card, with compact forms for sections the documents say little or nothing about.

components.name: CohortSummary
components.summary: For a trial with several cohorts: the best-matching cohort with its counts, and every other cohort collapsed to one row with its own counts.

components.name: CountPill
components.summary: A state pill with a number in front, so it reads as a short sentence: "6 met", "7 need a clinician".

components.name: CountsLine
components.summary: The four counts as one line of text with icons, "6 met · 0 not met · 9 not found · 7 need a clinician", for places where pills would be too heavy.

components.name: CriterionMatrix
components.summary: Every inclusion and exclusion criterion of one trial, each with its state, the evidence quote and the document and page, filterable by state.

components.name: DemoBadge
components.summary: Two badges that must never be missed: Fictional patient on every demo patient, Frozen demo whenever the app runs the frozen demo data.

components.name: DemoCaseCard
components.summary: The landing page card that introduces the fictional demo patient and starts the demo with "Find trials".

components.name: DocumentsTable
components.summary: The list of the case's documents, numbered in the order they were added; the numbers are the ones every compact source chip uses.

components.name: EvidencePanel
components.summary: The right-side panel that shows why a criterion has its state: the reasoning in one line, the trial's own wording, every source as a tab, the verbatim quote an…

components.name: FieldRow
components.summary: One line of the case card: a label, the value exactly as the documents give it, and its sources; or "not in the documents".

components.name: FileDropZone
components.summary: Where a coordinator adds one patient's documents; it numbers them in the order they will be cited.

components.name: FilterChip
components.summary: A toggle above the criterion matrix that shows only the rows in one state, with the count beside each state.

components.name: Footer
components.summary: The disclaimer line at the foot of every screen: "Karma organizes and cites documents.

components.name: Input
components.summary: A text field with its label above and its help or error below; errors are ink, not red.

components.name: ListStates
components.summary: How every list in Karma looks when it has nothing to show, is still working, or could not get its data.

components.name: SiteModeRow
components.summary: One patient against one trial in site mode: name, Fictional patient badge, the four count pills and the first not met criterion with its quote and source.

components.name: SourceChip
components.summary: A small button that names the exact document and page a value came from, and opens it.

components.name: SourceGroup
components.summary: One chip that stands for many sources ("8 sources in 5 documents") and opens in place, so a value with eight citations stays one line tall.

components.name: StateLegend
components.summary: Says what the four states mean, in the product's own words, wherever states first appear on a screen.

components.name: StatePill
components.summary: Shows one criterion's state as colour, icon and word together, which is the only way a state may appear.

components.name: TextLink
components.summary: Links in the bright blue accent (link, an alias of accent): underlined inside sentences, plain where their place makes them obvious (NCT IDs, "Open the criteri…

components.name: TimelineItem
components.summary: One dated event from the documents, in their words, with the sources it came from.

components.name: TrialRow
components.summary: One recruiting trial in the ranked list: rank, ID, phase, status, countries, title, the four count pills and the way into its criterion matrix.

components.name: Wordmark
components.summary: Three ways to write Karma; each works in the 64px header, on a title slide and in one colour, and each has a favicon mark.
